titre: if you only understand the lesson the night before the test #studytok #studytips #school #studymethod
notes: Routine du 1/11 (ROUTINE-avant-bleo, 6 livraisons). Schéma methods-per-subject (@studyy.hackz : 447 k le 10/10, valable jusqu'au 9/11). Plainte neuve : on ne comprend le cours que la veille (les autres plaintes : même méthode partout, oubli avant le contrôle, 4 tests, notes inutiles, révisions la veille, tout comme du vocabulaire, des heures sans progrès). Accroches écrites : « “I don't understand anything in class until the night before the test” » (retenue : la plainte entre guillemets, très partagée), « “I zone out in class and teach myself everything at home” » (écartée : plus longue), « “class makes no sense, YouTube does” » (écartée : cite une plateforme). Six gestes en cours, par matière, vrais et neufs chez nous : refaire l'exemple au tableau pendant qu'il est fait, noter les mots-clés de l'historien, reformuler la définition, la question « et donc ? » en littérature, le schéma pendant l'explication, la relecture de 5 minutes le soir même (place micabo, slide 7, se tester) ; téléphone éteint en classe (place UnSwipe, slide 8). Slides 7 et 8 sans personne.

slides.texte_overlay:
“I don't understand anything in class
until the night before the test”

the problem isn't you, it's what you do DURING class.
here's what each subject needs from you in the moment...

Copy the example, then cover it ✏️
Best for: Maths, Physics
while the teacher solves one on the board, try the next step before they write it.

Key words only 🗝️
Best for: History, Geography
not full sentences: dates, names, causes. you'll rebuild the rest later.

Your own words 💬
Best for: Biology, Economics
after each definition, write it again in a simpler sentence. if you can't, ask right away.

"so what?" 📚
Best for: Literature, Philosophy
next to each idea, write why it matters. that's the part the essay will ask for.

5 minutes the same evening 🧠
Best for: every subject
close your notes and test yourself on today's lesson. what you miss is what to ask tomorrow.

Phone off in class 📵
Best for: every subject
one notification and you miss the one sentence that explains everything.
